name: Degree-Three Two-Shore Carrier Census
definition: Enumerate the 63 nonempty ample subfamilies of $Q_3$ that avoid the zero word, and all 672 ordered disjoint pairs of such families.
properties: Every ordered disjoint pair has disjoint transversals of its inclusion-minimal words. After shrinking to minimal transversals of the actual lower and upper obstruction clutters, their union omits at most one residual direction. This certifies the isolated-support or one-step support-cover dichotomy at residual degree three.
